questions.text: Explain Molecular Orbital Theory (MOT). Draw the molecular orbital energy level diagram for $\text{O}_2$ and $\text{N}_2$ molecules, calculate their bond orders, and explain their magnetic behavior.
Derive the Nernst equation for single electrode potential: $E = E^\circ - \frac{2.303 RT}{nF} \log_{10}\left(\frac{1}{[M^{n+}]}\right)$ at $298\,\text{K}$.

Explain the electrochemical mechanism of rusting of iron (wet corrosion) involving anodic and cathodic reactions. Discuss cathodic protection methods (sacrificial anode and impressed current techniques).
Differentiate between temporary and permanent hardness of water. Describe the EDTA complexometric titration method for the determination of total hardness of water.
Define Gross Calorific Value (HCV) and Net Calorific Value (LCV). Describe the determination of calorific value of a solid fuel using Bomb Calorimeter with a neat diagram.
Describe the chemical composition and manufacturing of Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC) by the modern dry process with a flow chart.

Explain the construction and working of the standard Calomel electrode and Glass electrode with neat labeled diagrams.
Describe the Ion-Exchange (Demineralization) process of water softening with chemical reactions and a schematic diagram.
What are boiler troubles? Explain scale and sludge formation, caustic embrittlement, and priming/foaming, along with their prevention methods.
Differentiate between addition and condensation polymerization. Explain the preparation, properties, and engineering uses of Bakelite and Nylon-6,6.
What is Octane number and Cetane number? Explain how knocking in internal combustion engines can be minimized using anti-knocking agents.
